1492-2866-3899-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-3899-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-6559.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

777-1170-2099-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
777-1170-2099-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

654-3129-4094-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-3129-4094-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2060-6844-7889.description:
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Spider-Man 2099 spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{U}.
Repeat.

6441-6753-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer and Exalted Sunborn.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
6441-6753-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-3668.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-3668.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Mirror Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-3668.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2946-4556-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4556-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5555-6798-7666.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5434-5555-6798-7666.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

985-5078-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

406-1339-7307.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
406-1339-7307.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Raphael, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Tandem Lookout triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

11-799-2928-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-799-2928-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Karn's Temporal Sundering spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Karn's Temporal Sundering spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering and returning the original Karn's Temporal Sundering to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Karn's Temporal Sundering from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

141-2034-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-3108-3908.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Spark Double.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spark Double by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

478-3664-6871.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Lotus Field and Candelabra of Tawnos as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

469-518-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
469-518-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Insidious Will by paying its mana cost, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

1274-3490-5231-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-5231-6752.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1247-1606-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two mana-producing lands.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Ley Weaver and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-1606-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Ley Weaver's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands.
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1329-1750-2793-5261-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

3259-4897.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another nontoken creature you control that has haste.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard that has haste.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4897.description:
Declare Olivia and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Olivia triggers, returning a creature card that has haste from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature Olivia returned, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-2034-3723.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1086-3957-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
1086-3957-4702.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Anionter Priest and gaining you 1 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.
